# CANDIDATE: VWAP_PULLBACK_RIBBON_ALIGN_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In an uptrend defined by a bullish EMA ribbon (8>21>55), price pulling back to VWAP often finds support and resumes upward momentum. This setup captures that edge by requiring a confirmed bullish ribbon alignment, a VWAP bounce after at least two bars below VWAP, and a bullish close with above-average volume, making it more selective than a plain VWAP continuation.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** On a 5‑min bar, when the 8‑,21‑,55‑period EMA ribbon is bullish (close of 8‑EMA > close of 21‑EMA > close of 55‑EMA) AND the bar’s close crosses above VWAP after the prior two bars closed below VWap AND the bar is bullish (close > open) AND volume > 1.2× the 20‑bar average volume, then enter long at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop placed at the low of the entry bar (chart‑stop). TP1 at 1.5× risk (i.e., 1.5× (entry‑close – entry‑low)). Remaining position trailed with a chandelier exit (ATR×3) or exited if price closes below VWAP.
